OverDesk gathers your programs, web apps, tools and notes under one window. Same app on macOS and Windows.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1, M2, M3, M4…) | `OverDesk-…-macOS-AppleSilicon.dmg` |
| Mac with an Intel processor | `OverDesk-…-macOS-Intel.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 (any PC) | `OverDesk-…-Windows-Setup.exe` |
| Windows without installing | `OverDesk-…-Windows-x64-portable.zip` (or ARM64) |

No .NET install is needed; everything is included.

## First start

**macOS:** open the .dmg and drag OverDesk into Applications. The app is not notarized by Apple yet, so the first
start is blocked: open **System Settings → Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway** (or run
`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/OverDesk.app` in Terminal). To keep programs glued inside OverDesk,
allow it under **Accessibility**, and under **Screen Recording** for the live preview.

**Windows:** SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC" because the installer is not code-signed yet.
Click **More info → Run anyway**.
